title: 山月記
subtitle: Sangetsuki — The Moon over the Mountain
description: 中島敦の名作「山月記」。詩人として名を残そうとして、虎になってしまった李徴の物語から、人物・地名・印象的な言葉を集めました。
imagePrompt: A tiger standing on a grassy clearing at the edge of a misty forest, raising its head toward a pale setting moon at dawn, while a small party of travelers on horseback looks back from a distant hill; mountains of ancient China, dew on the grass. Square 1:1 composition. Antique copperplate engraving style with fine line work and cross-hatching, sepia ink on aged parchment paper, muted warm tones, 19th-century book illustration. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no border.
